risks.risk: No single Git commit matches live runtime
risks.impact: Fresh archive at HEAD misses BUILD_ID commit or dirty files; wrong UX/backend behavior
risks.source: BUILD_ID in container vs HEAD; 228 REQUIRED dirty paths
risks.mitigation: Option B forensic snapshot: effd130 + REQUIRED overlay; explicitly choose a5156ff for frontend-only parity

risks.risk: 228 uncommitted application files lost on naive clone
risks.impact: Forex/admin/backend regressions; infra-executor reads host tree
risks.mitigation: Export full list to initial commit in fresh repo

risks.risk: Production database not reconstructible from repo
risks.impact: User/ledger loss on fresh PG volume
risks.mitigation: pg_dump before cutover; restore to new volume

risks.risk: Secrets copied into fresh git history
risks.mitigation: Never copy .env; rotate all secrets on new repo deploy

risks.evidence: 89 commits behind HEAD; frontend image Sep 24
risks.mitigation: New deploy rev file tied to fresh initial commit + image digests

risks.risk: CI workflow does not match production branch or VPS images
risks.impact: GHCR images unused; drift between CI and VPS builds
risks.mitigation: Align branch triggers; single registry naming scheme

risks.impact: Empty redis/queues/WAL if project name changed carelessly
risks.mitigation: Keep compose project name or migrate volumes explicitly

risks.impact: Schema drift undetected on partial apply
risks.mitigation: Full migrate on empty DB; add versioning in future engineering

risks.risk: External provider URLs still point at old VPS
risks.mitigation: Provider dashboard updates at cutover window

risks.risk: Old lineage in image names and remotes
risks.mitigation: Rename images/registry; delete product remote from fresh clone

risks.risk: Frontend effd130 drawing cert not in live image
risks.impact: If snapshot=effd130 but no rebuild, behavior differs from BUILD_ID
risks.mitigation: Rebuild frontend after copy or base snapshot on effd130 intentionally

risks.risk: Admin image 10 days older than frontend
risks.mitigation: Rebuild admin from same snapshot as backend
